Risk: Adversarial misclassification in image classifiers
Problem analysis: Limited adversarial robustness guarantees in classifiers
Theoretical insight: Diffusion-based denoised smoothing increases certified robustness radius
Design rationale: Use higher-performing diffusion models in randomized smoothing
Implementation mechanism: Randomized smoothing with diffusion model denoising on perturbed inputs
Validation evidence: 14 percentage point improvement on ImageNet certified robustness via diffusion smoothing
Intervention: Apply diffusion-based randomized smoothing during pre-deployment testing to certify image classifier robustness
Source: https://newsletter.mlsafety.org/p/ml-safety-newsletter-6
